title: Bank Rate, 1929-1939: 1 January 1929 and every day on which it changed
source: Bank of England, 'A millennium of macroeconomic data for the UK' (version 3.1): sheet 'D1. Official Interest Rates'
series: date (ISO); bank_rate: Bank Rate, per cent, from that day ('Bank Rate 1833-1972, Minimum Lending Rate 1972-1981, Minimum Band 1 Dealing Rate 1981-1997, Repo Rate 1997-2006, Bank Rate, 2006-2016')
license: The workbook asks users to cite the underlying sources ('When using this data, please cite this source'). The Bank of England publishes it as a research dataset; a subset is stored here for teaching, with attribution to the Bank of England and to the authors of the series (the Bank of England for Bank Rate).
notes: Workbook SHA-256 4c23dd392a498691eac92659aec283fb43f28118bd80511dc87fc595974195eb (the copy used for Chapters 19-31). The first row is the rate in force on 1 January 1929; every later row is a day on which the rate changed.
citation: Bank of England, A Millennium of Macroeconomic Data for the UK, v3.1 (R. Thomas and N. Dimsdale, 2017), sheet D1
